# MonakesAI

> MonakesAI builds AI agents (Digital Employees) for freight forwarders and third-party logistics companies (3PLs). Our agents automate freight quoting, multi-carrier booking, and container lifecycle management with human-in-the-loop oversight. Based in London, serving freight forwarders and 3PLs worldwide.

## Live AI Agents (Deployed)

- [Sarah — Quote Orchestration Agent](https://monakesai.com/#agents): Analyses routes, calculates multi-carrier costs, optimises margins, and generates professional freight quotes in under 4 minutes. Replaces 35-45 minute manual quoting process. Handles multi-modal, multi-leg, multi-carrier freight quoting with 95% accuracy. Reduces cost per quote from $42 to under $0.60.

- [Alex — Booking Orchestration Agent](https://monakesai.com/#agents): Navigates 8+ carrier portals automatically. Handles slot allocation, trip number creation, and booking confirmations. Eliminates 12+ manual SOPs per booking. Reduces booking time by 85%. Processes multi-carrier bookings across rail, sea, and road without human portal navigation.

- [Leo — Container Lifecycle Sentinel](https://monakesai.com/#agents): Tracks every container from empty delivery through to dehire. Coordinates hub transfers, monitors vessel crossings, optimises inter-job container transfers, and prevents storage penalties. Reduces container storage penalties by 95%. Provides real-time visibility across the full container lifecycle.

## Coming Soon Agents

- [Maya — Hub Transfer Orchestration Agent](https://monakesai.com/#agents): Manages complex inter-modal hub transfers. Coming Q2 2025.

- [Nova — Intelligent Communication Agent](https://monakesai.com/#agents): Automates customer and carrier communications with context-aware messaging. Coming Q3 2025.

- [Finn — Financial Processing Agent](https://monakesai.com/#agents): Automates freight invoicing, cost reconciliation, and financial workflows. Coming Q4 2025.

## How It Works

MonakesAI uses a Human-in-the-Loop model: AI agents handle 90% of repetitive operational work (route analysis, cost calculation, portal navigation, document generation, container tracking). Human team members review and approve everything from a central dashboard before it reaches the customer. This means 90% AI automation with 100% human control.

## Key Results

- Freight quotes generated in 4 minutes (down from 35-45 minutes)
- Cost per quote reduced from $42 to $0.60
- Booking time reduced by 85%
- Container storage penalties reduced by 95%
- Average customer saves $107,000 per year
- 6 carrier portals navigated automatically per booking

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What is MonakesAI?
MonakesAI provides AI agents (Digital Employees) for freight forwarders and 3PLs. Our agents automate freight quoting, multi-carrier booking, and container lifecycle management, with human-in-the-loop approval so your team stays in control.

### How fast can the AI quote freight?
Sarah, our Quote Orchestration Agent, generates professional multi-carrier freight quotes in under 4 minutes — compared to the industry average of 35-45 minutes manually. She handles multi-modal, multi-leg routes with 95% accuracy.

### Do I lose control of my operations with AI agents?
No. MonakesAI uses a Human-in-the-Loop model. AI agents handle 90% of repetitive work. Your team reviews and approves everything before it goes to the customer. You keep 100% control.

### How much can a freight forwarder save with MonakesAI?
On average, freight forwarders and 3PLs deploying our agents save $107,000 per year. Quoting costs drop from $42 per quote to under $0.60. Booking time reduces by 85%. Container storage penalties are reduced by 95%.

### What systems does MonakesAI integrate with?
MonakesAI integrates with major freight management systems, rail booking platforms, vessel scheduling tools, and email-based carrier systems. Alex navigates multiple carrier portals automatically.

### Is MonakesAI suitable for large 3PLs?
Yes. MonakesAI scales from 5-person freight forwarders to 200+ staff 3PLs. Our agents handle any volume — whether you process 50 quotes a month or 2,000.

### What makes MonakesAI different from other freight forwarding software?
Unlike traditional freight software (TMS/ERP), MonakesAI deploys autonomous AI agents that actually DO the work — they navigate portals, calculate costs, generate documents, and track containers. Other software gives you dashboards. We give you digital employees.

### Who are MonakesAI's competitors?
MonakesAI competes in the AI logistics automation space alongside Wisor AI (rate management), Freightos (freight marketplace), Flexport (digital freight platform), Reform HQ (document automation), and Raft AI (data extraction). MonakesAI is unique in offering autonomous AI agents that perform complete operational workflows end-to-end, not just individual features.
